lessons.title: Welcome: From Midwife to Certified Light Therapist
lessons.topicSummary: Save the Uterus Club welcome and introduction of Tracy Donegan (registered midwife, founder of GentleBirth, author of Mindful Pregnancy, certified light therapist). Tracy's background: 14 years as a midwife, the GentleBirth app, and her initial skepticism of red light therapy claims before investigating the research.

lessons.title: Protocols, Not Gadgets: What Serious Light Therapy Looks Like
lessons.topicSummary: Why the therapy is not one-and-done: three-cycle protocols with monthly check-ins, health history and circadian light assessment. Oral mucositis as the flagship established use, standard of care in UK pediatric oncology units, and why it remains underused in the US.

lessons.title: Photobiomodulation 101: Wavelengths, Technique, and History
lessons.topicSummary: The proper term photobiomodulation (PBM); panels vs lasers; key wavelengths (660 nm window, 808-830 nm deep penetration); skin-contact application technique and why air gaps waste energy; non-thermal safety rules; blue light for newborn jaundice as precedent; Mester's early experiments and NASA research.

lessons.title: How It Works: Mitochondria, ATP, and Nitric Oxide
lessons.topicSummary: The cellular mechanism: chromophores absorb light, nitric oxide is displaced, ATP production rises, circulation improves, inflammation falls, stem cells are stimulated. Safety precautions (tattoos), clinical observations after cesarean, the post-COVID smell/taste recovery study in pregnant women, and the size of the evidence base (~1,800 RCTs, 13,000+ papers).

lessons.title: Applications Across Women's Health
lessons.topicSummary: Post-cesarean wound healing, mastitis, intimate health in menopause, lichen sclerosus. Wavelengths as prescriptions and the three-month re-evaluation rule. The Russian research tradition: low-level lasers on acupuncture points and intrauterine laser treatment of endometritis.

lessons.title: Tending the Soil: The Ovarian Ecosystem, Sunlight, and Melatonin
lessons.topicSummary: Fertility support framed as supporting the whole ovarian ecosystem rather than chasing egg quality; the role of natural sunlight in hormonal balance; melatonin as the cellular maintenance crew; night light exposure, metabolic effects, and miscarriage risk; the D Minder app for vitamin D.

lessons.title: Scrutinizing the Fertility Claims: What the Evidence Actually Says
lessons.topicSummary: Why many manufacturer-cited fertility studies are weak or confounded; the 2017 Morin study of ~1,000 IVF patients (laser vs acupuncture vs sham, non-significant trend toward better live birth); men's health applications including testicular pain and prostatitis protocols.

lessons.title: PCOS, Dosage, and What Clients Actually Report
lessons.topicSummary: PBM and blood glucose in PCOS; the Arndt-Schulz dose-response law (too little does nothing, correct power reaches target tissue); clinical observations of improved cervical mucus and regulated luteal phases; why Tracy refers clients to RRM practitioners for root-cause workup.

lessons.title: Hypertension in Pregnancy, TBI, and the Integration Gap
lessons.topicSummary: Brazilian research on light therapy for hypertension in pregnancy; intranasal devices normalizing blood pressure without harming mother or baby; labor pain and menstrual pain applications from China and Japan; the three-month objective-metric tracking approach; discussion of US healthcare fragmentation and layering low-risk therapies (laser plus progesterone for TBI).

lessons.title: Lasers vs LEDs, Predatory Devices, and Pelvic Protocols
lessons.topicSummary: Technical distinction between collimated lasers and scattering LEDs; predatory device marketing and invalid citations; cesarean scar healing beyond the surface (adhesion and isthmocele prevention); the 25-minute protocol with autonomic regulation; vaginal probe use on mucosal tissue; the partner-assisted protocol and why a receptive, relaxed state matters.

lessons.title: Light Environment, Antibiotic Resistance, and Getting This Into Medicine
lessons.topicSummary: Modern light environments and fight-or-flight physiology; challenging the sun-avoidance myth; University of Virginia 405 nm blue light research re-sensitizing MRSA to antibiotics; the case for pre/intra/post-operative PBM in gynecology and oncology; the patient-as-scientist research network idea, funding, and preeclampsia trial ambitions; consumer panels as ambient light, not therapy.

lessons.title: Practical Q&A: Cycle Timing, Pregnancy, and the Fibroid Investigation
lessons.topicSummary: When in the cycle to start laser therapy; pausing pelvic treatment after ovulation until a pregnancy test; surgical timing; the ongoing fibroid investigation cohort with follow-up imaging planned; future possibilities including liver support, myopia, and intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy.
